info.title: AID4T Engine API
info.description: One-stop, AI-agent-ready access to multi-source tornado data. Browse freely; sign in (free account) to download data or request processed results.

post.description: Create a free user account (curator roles are granted only by administrators).
Unified query: any combination of event / location / modality / time facets.

get.description: GET form of /api/query (convenient for curl, notebooks and agents).
Data AID4T Engine can deliver for the event. `include_unavailable=true` also lists what cannot be delivered and why.

post.description: AID4T Engine fetches the selected data from all sources, stages them on the AID4T Engine server and packages one zip.

get.description:
Computational provenance: code name/version/authors/validator + code digests, environment, inputs,
request parameters and output digests.

post.description: Re-run the identical request; the new job's `reproduction` block compares results, code and inputs.

Natural-language request → structured query → retrieved data → answer. Searching is open; downloads and
processed results need a signed-in user. Every exchange gets an auditable record (`ask_id`).

get.description: Record of an Ask T exchange: structured query, data sources, code and catalog versions, linked results.
Turns of an Ask T conversation (question, structured query, answer, results).

post.description: MCP over HTTP (stateless JSON-RPC). Send your API key as X-API-Key to use download/job tools.

Submit a dataset (link, or then upload the file with PUT .../file). It stays pending and invisible to other
users until an administrator or the data-category lead approves it.

put.description: Upload the file of a contribution (raw request body; e.g. curl -T data.nc '.../file?filename=data.nc').

get.description: Contributions this curator may review (leads see only their data types).

post.description: Approve (publish to AID4T permanent storage / catalog) or reject a pending contribution.

put.description: Publish a team dataset directly to AID4T permanent storage (curators only, within their data types).

get.description: Registered datasets that are not yet downloadable (must be obtained and ingested by the team).

Usage metrics: users by sector, active users, downloads/jobs/asks/contributions by month, data volume,
most-requested data types.

Event-level metadata and labels: lifecycle, labels and summary are open; the per-scan feature table
(`scans=true`) needs a free account.
Search radar scans across all events by feature values and labels (latest feature version per event).

post.description: Compute a new version of an event's metadata and labels (curators).

Generate an AI-ready federated dataset for a research objective: a versioned manifest that links raw data
at their sources, event metadata/labels and Zarr products for the selected events (nothing is copied).
Re-run the dataset's specification and publish a new immutable version (owner only).
Have AID4T Engine fetch the dataset's raw data from their sources and package one zip.

get.description: All analysis-ready, cloud-optimized (Zarr) products published by AID4T Engine (latest version of each).

Zarr products for an event, each with a ready-to-run Python (xarray) snippet. Listing is open; reading
the data needs a free account (send your API key as `X-API-Key`).

post.description: Build a new immutable version of a Zarr product for an event (curators).

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id
conversation_id.description: Continue a multi-turn conversation (returned by a previous /api/ask call); omit to start a new one

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: An option T offered for an ambiguous request ({query, workflow}); executed as given

tdn_ids.title: Tdn Ids
tdn_ids.description: AID4T event ids this dataset belongs to (legacy TDN- ids accepted)

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: Organisation / team that produced the data

license.title: License
license.description: SPDX-style id, e.g. CC0-1.0, PDDL-1.0, US-Government-Work, CC-BY-4.0, ODC-BY-1.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, ODbL-1.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0

url.title: Url
url.description: For kind=link: URL of the externally hosted resource

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Representative location (e.g. radar or camera position)

research_objective.title: Research Objective
research_objective.description: What the dataset is for (kept with the data)

name.title: Name
name.description: Short name; defaults to the start of the research objective

modalities.title: Modalities
modalities.description: Raw data types to link (empty = all available)

feature_label.title: Feature Label
feature_label.description: Keep only scans with this label, e.g. 'tornadic'

shared.title: Shared
shared.description: Visible to all signed-in users (default: only you)

query.description: Select events by query instead of ids

free_window.title: Free Window
free_window.description: Also include continuous-archive data for the query's place+time window (needs a query with location and time)

hrrr_subset.title: Hrrr Subset
hrrr_subset.description: HRRR: deliver only selected GRIB2 fields (~40 MB/h) instead of the original files (~530 MB/h); the extraction is recorded in the manifest

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.description: Workflow id, e.g. nearground_wind, climatology, event_package

query.description: Alternative to event_ids: select events by query

event_ids.title: Event Ids
event_ids.description: AID4T event identifiers (legacy TDN- ids accepted)

text.title: Text
text.description: Free-text match on event name / tags

require.title: Require
require.description: 'all'/'any': keep only events with all/any requested modality obtainable

include_free_window.title: Include Free Window
include_free_window.description: Also list continuous-archive resources for location+time
